The complete algorithm for building this structure is described in
   steps (d), (e), and (f) in Section 6.1.3 of [RFC5280]; steps (h),
   (i), and (j) in Section 6.1.4 of [RFC5280]; and steps (a), (b), and

notes:
Step (b) of Section 6.1.4 of RFC 5280 is where policy mappings change the tree: it sets the expected_policy_set of the mapped nodes, or deletes them when policy_mapping is 0. RFC 9618 itself replaces this step in Section 5.4 ("The following replaces step (b) in Section 6.1.4 of [RFC5280]"). Step (a) of Section 6.1.4 checks the policyMappings extension before step (b) uses it. The list in Section 3.1 leaves out both steps, so a reader who builds the tree from the listed steps alone does not apply policy mappings.
